title: 通訊式列車控制
summary: 本課聚焦無線列控資料可信度與端到端時間邊界。從位置回報時效邊界建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把多車共用頻道與無線備援共同原因連成可驗證的介面，最後以通訊試驗證據界限整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies trustworthy radio train-control data and end-to-end timing bounds. Start with position-report freshness bounds to define physical or information boundaries, connect many trains sharing a channel with common causes in radio redundancy as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through limits of communication-test evidence. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 位置回報時效邊界與車地控制時序鏈
stages.titleEn: Position-report freshness bounds & Train-to-wayside timing chain
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「位置回報時效邊界」與「車地控制時序鏈」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Position-report freshness bounds" and "Train-to-wayside timing chain": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 位置回報時效邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Position-report freshness bounds: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「位置回報時效邊界」如何影響通訊式列車控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Position-report freshness bounds” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Communications-based train control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元將回報的位置誤差與車輛在傳輸期間前進的距離合併，保持量測時刻的可追溯性。位置資料的數值誤差與資料變舊造成的位移應分開處理。即使感測器本身準確，封包等待與處理延遲仍會擴大當前位置的不確定範圍；接收時間不能取代量測時間，否則不同子系統可能各自認為資料是新的。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「位置回報時效邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Combine reported-position uncertainty with vehicle travel during transmission, preserving traceability to the original measurement instant rather than reception alone. Position measurement error and displacement accumulated while data ages are separate contributions. Even an accurate sensor can yield an uncertain current location after queuing and processing delays. Reception time cannot substitute for measurement time because subsystems could then each mistakenly regard stale information as new. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Position-report freshness bounds” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A newly received packet always contains the present position." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「位置回報時效邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Position-report freshness bounds”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 位置回報時效邊界
knowledge.text: 本單元將回報的位置誤差與車輛在傳輸期間前進的距離合併，保持量測時刻的可追溯性。位置資料的數值誤差與資料變舊造成的位移應分開處理。
knowledge.textEn: Combine reported-position uncertainty with vehicle travel during transmission, preserving traceability to the original measurement instant rather than reception alone. Position measurement error and displacement accumulated while data ages are separate contributions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A newly received packet always contains the present position. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「位置回報時效邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Position-report freshness bounds" is correct?
options: 封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置
本單元將回報的位置誤差與車輛在傳輸期間前進的距離合併，保持量測時刻的可追溯性。
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
optionsEn: A newly received packet always contains the present position.
Combine reported-position uncertainty with vehicle travel during transmission, preserving traceability to the original measurement instant rather than reception alone.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
quiz.explanation: 本單元將回報的位置誤差與車輛在傳輸期間前進的距離合併，保持量測時刻的可追溯性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Combine reported-position uncertainty with vehicle travel during transmission, preserving traceability to the original measurement instant rather than reception alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 位置回報時效邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Position-report freshness bounds: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「位置回報時效邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Position-report freshness bounds” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Formula y=v*t+e gives y=5.1 m. Boundary: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Preserve measurement, transmit and receive timestamps; replay injected delays and verify that the resulting bound encloses the reference position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。公式 y=v*t+e，代入得 y=5.1 m。邊界：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Formula y=v*t+e gives y=5.1 m. Boundary: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「位置回報時效邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Position-report freshness bounds", which statement holds?
options: 平均頻寬足夠就保證每一個封包都準時抵達
測試開始時時鐘一致就能保證整天時間戳都一致
原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。
optionsEn: Sufficient average bandwidth guarantees on-time arrival of every packet.
Clocks aligned at test start remain aligned for the entire day.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：列車速度 v=18 m/s；資料年齡 t=0.25 s；定位誤差界 e=0.6 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: train speed v=18 m/s; data age t=0.25 s; position error bound e=0.6 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 位置回報時效邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Position-report freshness bounds: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「位置回報時效邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Position-report freshness bounds” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。以「位置回報時效邊界」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Preserve measurement, transmit and receive timestamps; replay injected delays and verify that the resulting bound encloses the reference position. For position-report freshness bounds, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把資料年齡 t 從 0.25 改成 0.275 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 5.1 變為 5.55 m。先說明「位置回報時效邊界」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only data age t from 0.25 to 0.275 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 5.1 to 5.55 m. Explain the causal direction for position-report freshness bounds, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時鐘偏移會偽裝成網路延遲，重設時間戳又可能隱藏陳舊資料，需用獨立時間基準辨認。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Clock offset can imitate network delay, while timestamp replacement can conceal stale data; an independent time reference distinguishes them. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。以「位置回報時效邊界」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Preserve measurement, transmit and receive timestamps; replay injected delays and verify that the resulting bound encloses the reference position. For position-report freshness bounds, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把資料年齡 t 從 0.25 改成 0.275 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 5.1 變為 5.55 m。先說明「位置回報時效邊界」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only data age t from 0.25 to 0.275 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 5.1 to 5.55 m. Explain the causal direction for position-report freshness bounds, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「位置回報時效邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Position-report freshness bounds"?
options: 保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
狀態變數多一個只會多出一種狀態組合
optionsEn: Preserve measurement, transmit and receive timestamps; replay injected delays and verify that the resulting bound encloses the reference position.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adding one Boolean state variable creates only one additional combination.
quiz.explanation: 保留量測、傳送及接收三個時間戳，以延遲注入重播檢查界限是否包住真值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Preserve measurement, transmit and receive timestamps; replay injected delays and verify that the resulting bound encloses the reference position. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 位置回報時效邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Position-report freshness bounds: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「位置回報時效邊界」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Position-report freshness bounds” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時鐘偏移會偽裝成網路延遲，重設時間戳又可能隱藏陳舊資料，需用獨立時間基準辨認。回到「位置回報時效邊界」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Clock offset can imitate network delay, while timestamp replacement can conceal stale data; an independent time reference distinguishes them. Trace the input chain for position-report freshness bounds. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：定速與有界誤差的保守加總，非隨機誤差的均方根合成。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Constant speed and a conservative sum of bounded errors, not root-sum-square combination of random errors.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「封包剛收到就代表其中位置一定是現在的位置」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A newly received packet always contains the present position." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 時鐘偏移會偽裝成網路延遲，重設時間戳又可能隱藏陳舊資料，需用獨立時間基準辨認。回到「位置回報時效邊界」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Clock offset can imitate network delay, while timestamp replacement can conceal stale data; an independent time reference distinguishes them. Trace the input chain for position-report freshness bounds. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「位置回報時效邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Position-report freshness bounds" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
時鐘偏移會偽裝成網路延遲，重設時間戳又可能隱藏陳舊資料，需用獨立時間基準辨認。
每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Clock offset can imitate network delay, while timestamp replacement can conceal stale data; an independent time reference distinguishes them.
Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
quiz.explanation: 時鐘偏移會偽裝成網路延遲，重設時間戳又可能隱藏陳舊資料，需用獨立時間基準辨認。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Clock offset can imitate network delay, while timestamp replacement can conceal stale data; an independent time reference distinguishes them. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 車地控制時序鏈：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Train-to-wayside timing chain: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「車地控制時序鏈」如何影響通訊式列車控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Train-to-wayside timing chain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Communications-based train control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 本單元沿感測、車載處理、無線網路與地面處理追蹤事件，不用各設備平均值代替整體尾端。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。改善最快的一段通常影響有限，且平均延遲不能代表最壞尾端；定義一致的起訖事件，才能避免子系統都量到好看的數值卻漏掉交接等待。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「車地控制時序鏈」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Trace an event through sensing, onboard processing, radio and wayside processing without replacing end-to-end tail behaviour with subsystem averages. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation. Improving the fastest stage often yields little benefit, and mean latency does not represent its worst tail. Consistent start and end events prevent subsystems from reporting attractive numbers while overlooking handoff queues. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Train-to-wayside timing chain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「車地控制時序鏈」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Train-to-wayside timing chain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 本單元沿感測、車載處理、無線網路與地面處理追蹤事件，不用各設備平均值代替整體尾端。端到端延遲由量測、通訊、運算與致動串接而成。
knowledge.textEn: Trace an event through sensing, onboard processing, radio and wayside processing without replacing end-to-end tail behaviour with subsystem averages. End-to-end delay spans sensing, communication, computation and actuation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「車地控制時序鏈」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短

本單元沿感測、車載處理、無線網路與地面處理追蹤事件，不用各設備平均值代替整體尾端。
optionsEn: Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay.
The mean packet-loss rate completely determines communication reliability.
Trace an event through sensing, onboard processing, radio and wayside processing without replacing end-to-end tail behaviour with subsystem averages.
quiz.explanation: 本單元沿感測、車載處理、無線網路與地面處理追蹤事件，不用各設備平均值代替整體尾端。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace an event through sensing, onboard processing, radio and wayside processing without replacing end-to-end tail behaviour with subsystem averages. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 車地控制時序鏈：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Train-to-wayside timing chain: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「車地控制時序鏈」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Train-to-wayside timing chain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。公式 y=sense+network+compute+actuate，代入得 y=0.25 s。邊界：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Formula y=sense+network+compute+actuate gives y=0.25 s. Boundary: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「車地控制時序鏈」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Train-to-wayside timing chain", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s。
只要區間最小間距縮短全線運能必定同比提高
裝設兩套相同設備就能完全消除共同原因故障
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s.
Reducing open-line separation always increases whole-line capacity in the same proportion.
Installing two identical systems completely removes common-cause failures.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：量測時間 sense=0.03 s；網路時間 network=0.08 s；運算時間 compute=0.02 s；致動時間 actuate=0.12 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: sensing time sense=0.03 s; network time network=0.08 s; computation time compute=0.02 s; actuation time actuate=0.12 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 車地控制時序鏈：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Train-to-wayside timing chain: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「車地控制時序鏈」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Train-to-wayside timing chain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。以「車地控制時序鏈」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load. For train-to-wayside timing chain, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把網路時間 network 從 0.08 改成 0.088 s（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.25 變為 0.258 s。先說明「車地控制時序鏈」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only network time network from 0.08 to 0.088 s (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.25 to 0.258 s. Explain the causal direction for train-to-wayside timing chain, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。以「車地控制時序鏈」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。

For train-to-wayside timing chain, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. quiz.question: 要驗證「車地控制時序鏈」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Train-to-wayside timing chain"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。
測試覆蓋率達到百分之百就等於零故障風險
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Follow one event identifier through timestamps, check stage boundaries for overlap or gaps, and repeat under injected load.
One hundred percent test coverage means zero failure risk.
quiz.explanation: 沿同一事件編號串接時間戳，檢查每一段邊界是否重疊或漏算，並注入負載重測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

steps.title: 車地控制時序鏈：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Train-to-wayside timing chain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「車地控制時序鏈」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Train-to-wayside timing chain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。回到「車地控制時序鏈」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. Trace the input chain for train-to-wayside timing chain. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：各階段串行且時間確定，沒有平行重疊或隨機尾端。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Deterministic serial stages without overlap or random latency tails.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每個子系統平均很快就代表整體最壞延遲一定很短」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fast average subsystems guarantee a short worst-case end-to-end delay." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。回到「車地控制時序鏈」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。
knowledge.textEn: Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. Trace the input chain for train-to-wayside timing chain. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「車地控制時序鏈」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Train-to-wayside timing chain" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只知道平均丟包率就能完全判定通訊可靠性
時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The mean packet-loss rate completely determines communication reliability.
Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance.
quiz.explanation: 時間基準不同可造成負延遲假象；漏記排隊會使快速單元測試無法預測整合表現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Different clock references can create apparently negative delays; omitted queues prevent fast unit tests from predicting integrated performance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
